modes.provider: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio OpenAI-compatible endpoint

blindness: The reviewer receives a neutral title and patch only. Source issue titles, problem statements, labels, categories, severities, construction direction, and gold locations are withheld.
retry_policy: At most two attempts for transport errors, HTTP 408/409/429, and HTTP 5xx. Permanent HTTP errors and schema/repair failures are not retried.
selection_policy: All 50 fixed cases are reported in one deterministic shuffled order. No best-of selection and no case deletion.
classification_failure_policy: Provider/protocol failures are reported separately and excluded from TP/FP/FN/TN; they are never converted to negative predictions.
